title: jpa-2000-j1-unified-heavyweight
label: MASSIVE Akita

won.source: The promotion's served results of Tokyo Ryogoku Sumo Hall, 3 February 2001: the CORONATION tournament final.

lost.source: Still billed as Double Titles Champion on the Junior Struggle roster of 30 April 2001; no later change survives.

how: Beat Ryo Inoue with a released German suplex at 36:58 in the CORONATION tournament final, then was awarded the belts by Genji Yamato with Genichiro Matsumura's blessing.
note: The first champion under this promotion; defended against Rick Taylor at Tokyo Ryogoku Sumo Hall on 24 March 2001.
